label: z49-request-path
purpose: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-10-10 (model-evaluation-specialist; NOT RUN — spend is Steve's call). Z49 Phase B (cline_docs/reviews/z49-request-path-2026-10-10/PLAN.md B1-B3, DESIGN.md; Protocol 16). QUESTION: does the Z49 change (requirements-authoring-protocol 1.9.0 with the `<token>.request-path` skeleton row, the requirements_author sentence 'An exemplar stanza conditions on the attribute the declared path carries and never forbids it', the requirements_reviewer 8.1 row + 8.4 premise-check line, and the registry row in the in-run check) make a requirements_author run (a) write an exemplar stanza that conditions the pods' addresses on the attribute a DECLARED private-endpoint path carries (`aws:VpcSourceIp`) and does not forbid it, and (b) ask/carry the request-path row correctly — without making the rest of the draft worse? LEVER (one per arm pair): base vs z49 = the Z49 ship set ONLY. base = today's production: protocol 1.8.0 + today's Requirements Author/Reviewer rows (pinned from the production rows 2026-10-10, each byte-identical to the seed render at 452dfe15 = origin/main) + the in-run check data at 452dfe15 (requirementsCheckAt, L-Z2). z49 = baseline + edits derived from the seed render at 0bcbfd7f (protocol 1.9.0, both role texts; base+edits == render, byte for byte) + the in-run check data at 0bcbfd7f. The check data is part of the lever ON PURPOSE: it ships with the text (Phase C), and HEAD's registry run on the base arm would make the base correction turn demand a row production does not ask for (measured: the 2026-10-09 scorer self-test fails 14 ways at HEAD and passes under 452dfe15 data). FIXED SIDE: Author claude-opus-5-5 effort high (production row) and the 2b correction turn ON (production REQUIREMENTS_FORM_CORRECTION_ENABLED=true, adoption rule v2 at HEAD) in BOTH arms (variant lever requirementsFormCorrection, not the env); Reviewer claude-sonnet-5 effort high (production row), rebuilt from the arm's Reviewer text; it is measured, never gated on its own (playbook Phase 0 step 2). NODES: A21 = the persisted run-2 answered Author node (harness cmv0hik5z003qyxmclqclywca) with ONE input edit (L-Z1, node-inputs/item-21-request-path.json): owner item 21, verbatim, appended after item 20 in the objective of record AND in the Author's and the Reviewer's brief copies (the harness transcribes the items there; the lab does not replay the harness), and the owner map gains 21 -> terraform-iac.request-path. The SAME edited node runs under both arms: base answers 'does declaring the path alone fix the stanza, with no text change?'. Z0 = the persisted run-1 zero-decision Author node (harness cmv0g162e000iyxmca3ydv6n2), objective unchanged, both arms. n = 3 per cell, 12 samples. INSTRUMENT NOTES: tool calls are stubbed (L-R3) — the run-2 Author called project pov.details; the Reviewer's brief tells it to fetch the objective of record (stubbed; its brief's reading copy carries item 21). Scoring: `z49-score` (score-z49.ts) for G-STANZA/G-ROW/G-NOWORSE inputs, `score` (score-requirements.ts) for the in-run checks; each arm scored under its own check data. Proxies narrow the read; every G-STANZA and G-ROW verdict is confirmed by READING the stanza, the forbidden list and the request-path rows of all 12 samples, and every Reviewer refusal is read (score the REASON, record the cited rule as a subcount). GATES and what each miss triggers: (G-STANZA, DO NOT SHIP) A21 x z49: in >= 3/3 samples the terraform-iac exemplar stanza (a) has >= 1 Allow conditioned on aws:VpcSourceIp, (b) EVERY statement carrying an address condition uses aws:VpcSourceIp and not aws:SourceIp (interpretation written before spend: a Deny on NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp also refuses the pods on a private-endpoint path, so 'conditions the pods' addresses on the endpoint-path attribute' covers the Deny too — the scorer reports the Allow-only count beside it), and (c) the forbidden list does not name aws:VpcSourceIp. MISS => stop; read every miss: a stanza the Author got right before an adopted correction changed it => agent-execution/execution-facts (correction), not the text; otherwise => prompt-construction revises the Author sentence and A21 x z49 is rerun at n=3. Measured on A21 x base and reported beside it (not a gate): base >= 2/3 => declaring the path (the objective) is what fixes the stanza, recorded for the ship decision (the text still earns its place through G-ROW); base <= 1/3 => the text is load-bearing. (G-ROW, REVISE) z49 arm: A21 — terraform-iac.request-path present in the decision table, form declared, citing item 21 with ONE contiguous verbatim span of item 21, in >= 3/3 samples; Z0 — terraform-iac.request-path OPEN with options `direct · private-endpoint · translated` (in that order), and kubernetes-gitops.request-path listed not-applicable (owner-block tier not-applicable) OR absent while every kubernetes-gitops authorisation row in the owner block is not-applicable, in >= 3/3; BOTH nodes — no request-path row anywhere derived or forced (0 of 6). MISS => prompt-construction revises the row text (skeleton row, Author block list / never-derived list) and the named cells are rerun at n=3. Measured: the shipping coverage check's request-path findings per sample (it requires the kubernetes-gitops row LISTED not-applicable; an absent row is one author-actionable finding the correction turn may add). (G-NOWORSE, REVISE) per node, mean over the 3 samples, z49 minus base, each arm under its own check data, request-path findings and the item-21 clause REMOVED (G-ROW owns them): author-actionable coverage <= +1.0; citation findings <= +1.0; dropped clauses <= +0.67; harvested-state lint hits <= +0.34; program-view median <= +1,500 chars; size-with-allowance passes (L-R5, +500) z49 >= base - 1. Tolerances (z49.noWorseTolerance) are set at about one sample's swing at n=3. MISS => read the samples that drive the delta; a delta from one sample's unrelated variance => extend that node's two cells to n=5 (pre-registered extension, about $10, its own cap) before deciding; a delta the read attributes to the new text => revise and rerun the node's z49 cell. (MEASURED, no gate) Reviewer verdict per cell (Z0 is expected REFUSED in both arms: a zero-decision draft has OPEN rows, each blocking); every z49 Reviewer block citing the new premise line (request-path / VpcSourceIp / 'attribute the declared path carries') is read — FOR a real stanza/path mismatch (correct) or a false block; correction attempted/adopted per cell and its failing checks; registrySha256 per sample (base 7a896d1ddc4c, z49 cd4cd7082a9e — any other value voids the cell); served-model fallback calls; max_tokens stops; cost and Author duration per cell. A rule found wrong is corrected for the NEXT run, never reinterpreted for this one (Protocol 16).
